# JARVIS v2.3.3 Release Notes

> ⚠️ **MANDATORY UPDATE NOTICE:**  
> Naya version (v2.3.3) install karna zaroori hai. Obsolete versions par access block kar diya gaya hai.

### What's New in v2.3.3:

- **Afreen Real Girlfriend Mode Overhaul:** 
  Natural human speech dynamics, sweet teasing, caring scolding ("haq se daantna"), bedtime pillow talk, and zero robotic or servant-like phrasing.
- **Neural Audio Vocoder Glitch Fix:** 
  Completely eliminated trailing emoji artifacts (such as "ran", "ram", "radhe") from live spoken audio while maintaining contextual emojis in chat UI.
- **Dynamic 4-in-1 Adaptive Moods:** 
  Seamless real-time emotional transitions (Romantic, Teasing, Caring Sanctuary, Casual Everyday) without manual mode toggling.
- **Zero Raw Emojis in Audio Stream:** 
  Enforced 100% pure human spoken words with natural sentence closure.
- **Performance & Stability:** 
  Optimized live prompt tokens and ultra-fast WebSocket audio responsiveness.
